article-details.looks: A blog article's header (title, author, date, header image under an optional overlay) and its body of text and image items.
article-details.use: Only on blog pages, which the backend generates.

fields.headerImage: The header image; the blog's thumbnail elsewhere on the site comes from it.
fields.heroContentPosition: left (default), center or right for the title over the header image.

fields.bodyText: A run of article copy: paragraphs, lists, sub-headings and links.
